name: Left Click Player 2
description: Bind Player 2's jump to the left mouse button, or to any other mouse button / key, in two-player mode.

exclusive.name: Bound button ONLY controls Player 2
exclusive.description: When enabled, the bound button no longer makes Player 1 jump, so it is dedicated to Player 2. When disabled, it makes both players jump.

mouse-button.name: Mouse button
mouse-button.description: 0 = Left, 1 = Right, 2 = Middle, 3 = Button 4, 4 = Button 5. Easiest way to set this: press the "Bind mouse button" button below.

bind-mouse.name: Bind mouse button
bind-mouse.description: Click this, then press the mouse button you want Player 2 to use.

buttons.start: Click, then press a mouse button

keyboard-bind.name: Keyboard bind (optional)
keyboard-bind.description: Optional extra key that also controls Player 2.

debug-logs.name: Debug logs
debug-logs.description: Logs each handled input to the Geode log.
